chunks: We and our fathers were promised this before; it is nothing but ancient lore!
ai.seo_question: What did the disbelievers say about the promise of resurrection?
ai.summary: In this verse, the disbelievers of Mecca dismiss the promise of resurrection as 'myths of the ancients,' echoing the skepticism of earlier nations like Noah's and Abraham's communities. Shia exegetes highlight this as a recurring pattern of denial where materialists reduce divine revelation to folklore, emphasizing that the core message of the Hereafter remains consistent across prophetic missions.
